title: Style videos
meta_description: Short styling videos from the boutique: how each piece moves, what it is made of, and the top we styled it with. Watch before you buy.
intro: Photos tell you the colour. Video tells you how a skirt moves, where a waistband sits and whether a fabric is as good as it looks. We film every rack before it goes online, so you can see a piece the way you would see it in the shop.
content: Each video has the written version under it — the fabric, the fit, how we styled it and the questions people ask. Read it with the sound off, or watch it and skip to the part you care about.
